description: A mobile app that lets users log their daily step count and displays a running weekly total. No health claims are made and no data is used for diagnosis or treatment.

A smartphone application that calculates a patient-specific insulin dose recommendation based on entered blood glucose readings and carbohydrate intake, intended for use by diabetic patients to guide dosing decisions.
Software that analyzes retinal fundus images and provides a diagnostic output indicating the presence or absence of diabetic retinopathy, intended to inform treatment decisions by an ophthalmologist.
A hospital scheduling system that manages operating room bookings and staff rosters, with no diagnostic, therapeutic, or monitoring function related to individual patients.

Software intended to control the delivery of a closed-loop insulin pump by continuously adjusting infusion rates based on real-time continuous glucose monitor readings, directly determining therapy without clinician review.

Software that aggregates a patient's electronic health records from multiple hospital systems into a single read-only viewer for clinicians, without performing any analysis, interpretation, or decision support.
An algorithm that monitors continuous ECG telemetry from hospitalized cardiac patients and generates real-time alerts for clinically significant arrhythmias requiring immediate intervention.
